'''B'Nal''' was a small [[lake]] located near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[A'Lenba]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. Its name literally meant "The Promise" in the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] language. [[Water/Legends|Water]] from the B'Nal was used in A'Lenba, but only after being filtered and purified.
